title: Matrix traversal and direction arrays
summary: Rows, columns, bounds checks, the dr/dc direction arrays for neighbours, and flattening (r, c) into one index.

sections.title: Basics
sections.body:
✍️ `int R = g.size(), C = g[0].size();` Cell (r, c) is valid iff `0 <= r < R && 0 <= c < C`.
✍️ Row-major traversal: outer loop over r, inner over c (fast, cache-friendly).

sections.title: Direction arrays
Flattening a cell to an index
sections.body: ✍️ `id = r * C + c`, and back: `r = id / C`, `c = id % C`. Useful for union-find on grids, visited arrays and BFS queues of ints.

sections.title: Diagonals
sections.body: Cells on the same **main** diagonal share `r − c`; on the same **anti**-diagonal share `r + c`. Used in N-Queens and diagonal traversal problems.
